summary_md: **Nitesh Rijal ([@openrijal](https://x.com/openrijal/status/2116207540308447374))** describes a workflow stitched from others' skills where the rules between them are the hard part: grill-me and to-prd for product decisions, LID for specs and EARS requirements, then pstack modes for implementation, verification and statecharts, with plans naming requirements and completion evidence ([mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), [jszmajda/lid](https://github.com/jszmajda/lid), [pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack), [blog](https://niteshrijal.com/blog/coding-workflow)).
